### Bible Pathways 09/05/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-09-or-05-or-2002-1147232.html
Passage: Ezekiel 17:1-4
Points:
- The colorful eagle in the parable represents King Nebuchadnezzar and his conquest of Judah.
- Zedekiah was planted as a low vine designed to remain stable and peaceful under Babylonian rule.
- Seeking Egyptian military alliances violated sacred vows and brought destruction upon Jerusalem.
- Believers remain strictly accountable to honor all promises and covenants made before God.
